property_summary: For every caller and every non-zero new owner, a transferOwnership attempt either reverts (caller not owner) or leaves owner() equal to the intended new owner only when the caller IS the owner; the mutant lets any caller succeed, so owner() changes when a non-owner calls, breaking the rule.
change_summary: Remove the _checkOwner() call so any caller can execute transferOwnership, changing the resulting owner() value observable after the call.
